cues.text: Every breakthrough begins with a question.
What if intelligence could do more?
I turn complex ideas into intelligent systems.
From AI agents to real-world platforms.
and I'm building what comes next.

visuals.text: Points of light draw a constellation across a dark frame; a close-up portrait emerges beside the word “question”.
An orbital diagram of an agent loop — planner, retriever, tool call, evaluator — around a glowing core. The words “Automate” and “Respond” appear and are struck through.
“Build” fills the frame and a five-layer stack assembles: Interface (React / Next.js), APIs (NestJS / FastAPI), Agents (LangGraph / RAG), Data (PostgreSQL / Redis), Cloud (Docker / Kubernetes / AWS).
Project frames branch out of the stack: TIBYN (“aquaculture SaaS · live”), MOViD Studio (“agentic video production”) and AI Agents (“multi-agent · RAG · tool calling”).
A framed portrait in a warmly lit room, then the name card: “Islam Abdelhady — AI Engineer · Technical Lead — Building what comes next.”
